description: Reviews HTML sanitization against WordPress 7.2's transitional KSES implementation. Use for wp_kses, wp_kses_post, pre_kses, custom allowlists, wp_kses_force_legacy_parser, or HTML API parser migrations. Distinguishes the default HTML API parser from the legacy fallback and tests security and output compatibility.
